pois.label: Timepix4 探测头塔
pois.detail: 塔顶开放式探测头竖着三层 Timepix4 粒子相机(55 µm 像素,300 µm 硅):A 层裸硅只认带电粒子,是参考道;B 层贴 1 mm 聚乙烯转换层,快中子在里面撞出反冲质子才被看见;C 层贴 6LiF 薄膜,热中子俘获放出 α+氚。三层错位排开,每层前缘从地面都能读出来——裸层与转换层的差值就是中子谱。
pois.detail_en: The open head stacks three Timepix4 particle cameras (55 µm pixels, 300 µm Si): layer A is bare silicon — charged particles only, the reference channel; layer B wears a 1 mm polyethylene converter — fast neutrons only become visible by knocking out recoil protons; layer C wears a 6LiF film — thermal neutrons capture into α+triton. The layers are stepped so each front edge reads from the ground; the bare-minus-converter difference IS the neutron spectrum.

specs.工作点: 150 V 背偏 · 阈值 500 e(冻结检查点)
specs.转换层: A 裸硅 / B 1 mm HDPE / C 2 µm ⁶LiF

specs_en.Operating point: 150 V backside bias · 500 e threshold (frozen checkpoint)
specs_en.Converters: A bare Si / B 1 mm HDPE / C 2 µm 6LiF

sim: 器件冻结检查点(自有 Timepix4 战役,Sentaurus 2D 场 + Allpix + Spectre AFE):p-spray d03 隔离、150 V/500 e 工作点全图均匀性 std 0.0017、最差点收集 0.492;中心/边/角 1/2/4 像素分摊拓扑逐点验证;stack-3 CSA ENC 52.7 e,30/30 端到端事件 ToT-电荷相关 0.9923
中子账(账3):1 mm HDPE n-p 反冲效率 0.02%→0.39%(1→14 MeV,含反冲逃逸 MC);⁶LiF 2 µm 热俘获 1.13%(含 95% ⁶Li 富集假设);对表 RAD 快段通量 0.05 n/cm²/s → 快道 2.2 计数/时、热道 ~85 计数/时——中子道就是慢,小时级出谱
sim_en: Frozen device checkpoint (own Timepix4 campaign: Sentaurus 2D field + Allpix + Spectre AFE): p-spray d03 isolation, 150 V/500 e operating point, full-map uniformity std 0.0017, worst-point collection 0.492; 1/2/4 pixel-sharing topology verified at center/edge/corner; stack-3 CSA ENC 52.7 e, ToT-charge correlation 0.9923 over 30/30 end-to-end events

Neutron ledger (#3): 1 mm HDPE n-p recoil efficiency 0.02%→0.39% (1→14 MeV, recoil-escape MC included); 6LiF 2 µm thermal capture 1.13% (assuming 95% 6Li enrichment); against the RAD fast-band flux 0.05 n/cm²/s → 2.2 counts/hr fast, ~85 counts/hr thermal — the neutron channel is honestly slow, spectra on the hour scale
pois.physics: 中子不带电,硅直接看不见——必须先在转换层里变成带电粒子:快中子打氢核最有效(n-p 弹性,质量相同能量转移最大),热中子靠 ⁶Li(n,α)t 的 940 b 大截面。裸层同时在场,把带电粒子本底当场扣掉。
pois.physics_en: Neutrons carry no charge — silicon alone is blind. A converter must first turn them into charged particles: fast neutrons scatter best off hydrogen (equal masses, maximum energy transfer), thermal neutrons use the 940 b 6Li(n,α)t capture. The bare layer runs alongside to subtract the charged background on the spot.

pois.label: 实时径迹大屏
pois.detail: 监测站的灵魂:芯片上每一次穿越都以簇形态直播在屏上。绿色卷曲链=电子(多次散射打弯);橙色直粗棒、末端更亮=质子(布拉格峰收尾);红色饱和斑+放射状 δ 电子辐条=重离子。SEP 事件时整屏变成质子雨——警报塔同步转红。
pois.detail_en: The station's soul: every traversal of the chip is replayed live as a cluster shape. Green curly chains = electrons (bent by multiple scattering); thick straight amber bars brightening at one end = protons (ending in a Bragg peak); saturated red blobs with radial delta-ray spokes = heavy ions. During an SEP event the whole screen turns into proton rain — and the alert tower goes red with it.

specs.分类判据: 簇尺寸 × 直线度 × 单像素 ToT
specs.电子: ≥5 像素卷曲链 · 低 ToT
specs.质子: 直线 2–15 像素 · ToT 5–30× MIP · 布拉格端
specs.重离子: 饱和核 + δ 晕 · ToT >600× MIP

specs_en.Proton: straight 2–15 px · ToT 5–30× MIP · Bragg end
specs_en.Heavy ion: saturated core + delta halo · ToT >600× MIP

pois.sim: 径迹账(账2):MIP 在 300 µm 硅 MPV 22.8 ke = 阈值 46×,最坏 4 路角分摊仍 11×——分类受形态不受阈值限制;LET 阶梯:e⁻ 0.24 / MIP 质子 0.42 / 10 MeV 质子 8.1 / Fe(1 GeV/u) 286 keV/µm;Fe 单击沉积 ~2350 万 e⁻,与电子相差 4 个量级,ToT 一眼分开
pois.sim_en: Track ledger (#2): MIP MPV in 300 µm Si is 22.8 ke = 46× threshold, still 11× under the worst 4-way corner split — classification is morphology-limited, not threshold-limited; the LET ladder: e⁻ 0.24 / MIP proton 0.42 / 10 MeV proton 8.1 / Fe (1 GeV/u) 286 keV/µm; one Fe hit deposits ~23.5 Me⁻, four decades above an electron — ToT separates them at a glance
pois.physics: Bethe-Bloch:电离损失 ∝ z²/β²,铁核 z²=676 倍于质子——这就是重离子饱和斑的来历;电子质量小,多次散射角大,径迹必然卷曲;慢化质子越走越慢、越慢损失越大,正反馈堆出布拉格峰。形态即物理。
pois.physics_en: Bethe-Bloch: ionization loss ∝ z²/β², an iron nucleus ionizes 676× a proton — hence the saturated blob; electrons are light, so multiple scattering bends them into curls; a stopping proton slows, loses more, slows further — the positive feedback piles up the Bragg peak. Morphology is the physics.

pois.label: LET 谱产品面板
pois.detail: 大屏旁的窄屏是本站的第二产品:每条径迹的沉积能除以径长得到硅中 LET,24 个对数箱 0.1–1000 keV/µm,以及 SEL 判据直接消费的积分形式 φ(>L)。面板上的柱形只是产品形状的示意(MIP 峰、幂律下落、铁峰)——本站至今没有一条实测谱,它标的是「出谱以后长什么样」。硅中 LET 原生可测、不经换算,正是计算中心要的量;换算到水中只为算 Q(L)。
pois.detail_en: The narrow screen beside the main display is the station's second product: every track's deposited energy over its path length gives an LET in silicon, in 24 log bins from 0.1 to 1000 keV/µm, plus the integral form φ(>L) that an SEL criterion consumes directly. The bars are a glyph of the product's shape (MIP peak, power-law fall, iron bump) — the station has measured no spectrum yet; the panel shows what one will look like. LET in silicon is measured natively, no conversion, which is what the compute centre needs; the conversion to water exists only to evaluate Q(L).

specs.重建链: 簇 → 投影长 + 能量 → 穿透/停止判别 → LET_Si → ×0.52 换算水中(Bethe 比,β 0.5–0.95 内 0.518–0.533)
specs.硬闸(账 14): 重建谱积分回测试族自己的 D、H:|ΔD|≤5%、|ΔH|≤10% —— 1.2/1.44 族过(H −5%/−6%),2.0/2.5 族 H −11%/−24% 红:停止质子份额越大单层丢得越多
specs.已知答案: 5 MeV 质子射程 214 µm(参考 221)· MIP MPV/均值 0.75 · Fe 1 GeV/u 受限能损份额 0.906 @T_cut 300 keV · 增益 +5% → LET +5.00%
specs.最大系统差: 账 19 用冻结前端的晶体管网表(Spectre,TSMC65)实测:hit 宽度在 150 e–3 ke 恒为 ~143 ns 与电荷无关,30 ke–500 ke 才以 1.4–2.7 ns/ke 上升,≥1 Me 钳位(输入节点 −0.6 V,加保护结后 1 Me 损失 51%);反馈电流 ×10 无效。前端原样反演 D 读高 1.8×、只算饱和 H 只剩 0.50;外围像素重建在横向展宽 ≥20 µm 时救回 0.90。原写「1e5/3e5/1e6 e 硬截断 H 0.21/0.24/0.32」是账 14 的占位扫描,已被账 19 取代(2026-09-09)
specs.统计(采用通量 3 cm⁻²s⁻¹): 1.8e6 径迹/sol · D 到 1% <1 h · H 到 5% 0.4 sol · >100 keV/µm 各箱到 10% 2.2 sol —— 统计上是一次测量,但锚自身太阳周期起伏 31% ⇒ 产品是时间序列
specs.等级: 设计仿真产品,无数据(账 14–17 的合成测试族,不是火星)

specs_en.Reconstruction chain: cluster → projected length + energy → through/stop call → LET_Si → ×0.52 to water (Bethe ratio, 0.518–0.533 over β 0.5–0.95)
specs_en.Hard gate (ledger 14): reconstructed spectrum must integrate back to the test family's own D and H: |ΔD|≤5%, |ΔH|≤10% — the 1.2/1.44 families pass (H −5%/−6%), the 2.0/2.5 families fail on H (−11%/−24%): the larger the stopping-proton share, the more a single layer loses
specs_en.Known answers: 5 MeV proton range 214 µm (reference 221) · MIP MPV/mean 0.75 · Fe 1 GeV/u restricted-loss fraction 0.906 at T_cut 300 keV · gain +5% → LET +5.00%
specs_en.Largest systematic: Ledger 19 measured the frozen front end's transistor netlist (Spectre, TSMC65): the hit width is ~143 ns from 150 e to 3 ke regardless of charge, rises at 1.4–2.7 ns/ke only between 30 ke and 500 ke, and clamps above ~1 Me (input node at −0.6 V; 51% of the charge lost at 1 Me with a protection junction); a tenfold feedback current changes nothing. Inverting the front end as frozen reads D 1.8× high; saturation alone leaves H at 0.50; periphery reconstruction recovers 0.90 when the lateral spread is ≥20 µm. The earlier '1e5/3e5/1e6 e hard clip, H 0.21/0.24/0.32' was ledger 14's placeholder scan, superseded by ledger 19 (2026-09-09)
specs_en.Statistics (adopted flux 3 cm⁻²s⁻¹): 1.8e6 tracks/sol · D to 1% in <1 h · H to 5% in 0.4 sol · each >100 keV/µm bin to 10% in 2.2 sol — statistically one measurement, but the anchor's own solar-cycle swing is 31%, so the product is a time series
specs_en.Grade: design-simulated product, no data (synthetic test families of ledgers 14–17, not Mars)

sim: 逐事件 LET 重建账(账 14):九道预注册闸(e2c966e)——射程、Landau、角不变性、δ 逃逸、增益、阈值、换算、闭合、形状;测试族由两个 RAD 积分约束 + 背景知识形状构造,五个质子族 ⟨Q⟩ 目标 {1.05, 1.2, 1.44, 2.0, 2.5},1.05 不可行(硅内 nσt 反冲已给 1.18);闭合是成对比较,与 RAD 无关;形状闸自身有误(把族里 C/O 肩和停止质子峰判成不物理)已退役为描述;三项预注册预期落空并记账:无深度支永远不会红、深度信息对 LET 几乎无用、D 原始值 −7% 而非 <2%

微分谱产品账(账 16):P1 φ(LET_Si) 与 φ(>L)——单层 φ(>1 keV/µm) 直接读高 46%(Landau 长尾把 MIP 挪上去),φ(>100) 只剩 0.10(靶碎片反冲在一像素里与停止质子不可分,单层数不到);P2 分种类 φ(E) 不给;P3 快中子 1–3/3–10/10–100 MeV 三箱反解 30 sol 内 −10%/−2%/+15%(第三箱靠 14 MeV 以上的外推响应);P4 SEP γ 在 1e4 事件统计 ±0.03,但探测器失配(+5% 增益、15 µm 扩散)偏 +0.1–0.4 ⇒ 分硬软不分细
统计账(账 17):σ_H/H 每 sol 3.2%(公式与 bootstrap 一致);暴风时质子带 ×30 ⇒ ⟨Q⟩ 2.9 → 1.13;双累加器:平静累加器黄警即冻,冻结后偏 −0.01%、不冻则 +97%;3×/30× 计数判据在上游不动;10 min 暴风直方图 γ 统计误差 0.005 —— 限制全在系统

AFE 饱和账(账 19,预注册 d9c6f83):34 个 Spectre 网表(原样 / 加保护结 / 反馈 ×10),已知答案 143.01 对 143.04 ns@300 e;七闸 3 绿 4 红——无线性区(G19.2)、1 Me 损失 51% 而非 ≥70%(G19.4)、500 e–1 ke 双脉冲(G19.5)、G19.3 绿得没道理(斜率与 I_fb 无关)。冻结网表无输入保护是跑之前登记的事实。设计结论:LET 产品需要不被 hit 复位定宽的恒流放电 ToT 通路;像素钳位 ~500 ke 由外围重建补,前提横向展宽 ≥20 µm
sim_en: Per-event LET reconstruction (ledger 14): nine pre-registered gates (e2c966e) — range, Landau, angle invariance, δ escape, gain, threshold, conversion, closure, shape; test families built from the two RAD integrals plus background-knowledge shapes for five proton-family ⟨Q⟩ targets {1.05, 1.2, 1.44, 2.0, 2.5}, 1.05 infeasible (in-silicon recoils at nσt alone give 1.18); closure is a paired comparison and never touches RAD; the shape gate was itself wrong (it flagged the family's own C/O shoulder and stopping-proton peak as unphysical) and is retired to a description; three registered expectations missed and are scored: the no-depth branch could never fail, depth information is nearly irrelevant to LET, raw D is −7% rather than under 2%

Spectrum products (ledger 16): P1 φ(LET_Si) and φ(>L) — a single layer reads φ(>1 keV/µm) 46% high (the Landau tail migrates MIPs upward) and φ(>100) at 0.10 of truth (target-fragment recoils in one pixel are indistinguishable from stopping protons, so a single layer cannot count them); P2 φ(E) per species not given; P3 fast-neutron unfolding into 1–3/3–10/10–100 MeV at 30 sols −10%/−2%/+15% (the third bin rides on an extrapolated response above 14 MeV); P4 SEP γ to ±0.03 statistically at 1e4 events, but a mismatched sensor (+5% gain, 15 µm diffusion) shifts it by +0.1 to +0.4 ⇒ hard versus soft, not fine γ

Statistics (ledger 17): σ_H/H 3.2% per sol (formula and bootstrap agree); a 30× proton band takes ⟨Q⟩ from 2.9 to 1.13; two accumulators, the quiet one frozen from yellow: −0.01% frozen versus +97% unfrozen; the 3×/30× count thresholds sit upstream and do not move; γ per 10-minute storm histogram to 0.005 statistically — every limit is systematic

AFE saturation (ledger 19, pre-registered d9c6f83): 34 Spectre decks (as frozen / with a protection junction / feedback ×10), known answer 143.01 vs 143.04 ns at 300 e; seven gates, 3 green 4 red — no linear range (G19.2), 51% rather than ≥70% loss at 1 Me (G19.4), a double pulse at 500 e–1 ke (G19.5), and G19.3 green for the wrong reason (the slope has nothing to do with I_fb). The absence of input protection in the frozen deck was registered before the run. Design consequence: the LET product needs a constant-current discharge ToT path not width-fixed by the hit-driven reset; the ~500 ke per-pixel clamp is recovered by periphery reconstruction provided the lateral spread is ≥20 µm
pois.physics: 薄硅层的逐事件 LET 是 Landau 涨落后的量:MIP 的最概然沉积只有平均值的 0.75,长尾把约 5% 的 MIP 挪到 1 keV/µm 以上——所以 φ(>1) 单层直接读高 46%,谱产品必须带响应反卷积。δ 电子带走 ~10% 能量逃出 300 µm,受限→非受限按 β 补回。停止径迹的 LET 靠能量 + 射程表(E 低于穿层能量 6.1 MeV、投影长不超过质子射程),不靠 ToA 深度:深度对 LET 几乎无用,这是本轮推翻自己预注册的一条。
pois.physics_en: Per-event LET in a thin silicon layer is a Landau-fluctuated quantity: a MIP's most probable deposit is 0.75 of its mean, and the long tail moves about 5% of MIPs above 1 keV/µm — so a single layer reads φ(>1) 46% high and the product needs a response unfolding. δ electrons carry ~10% of the energy out of 300 µm; the restricted→unrestricted map restores it by β. A stopping track's LET comes from energy plus the range table (energy below the 6.1 MeV crossing energy, projected length within the proton range), not from ToA depth: depth is nearly useless for LET, one of this round's overturned pre-registrations.

pois.label: 质子族分类牌
pois.detail: 单层 Timepix4 真能分开的类只有三种,牌上三色就是它们:停止径迹(能量低于穿层能量 6.1 MeV、投影长不超过质子射程、单像素或 Bragg 上升)、轻穿透(LET ≤10 keV/µm)、重穿透。玻璃厂账 22 要的「质子族 ⟨Q⟩」(p/d/t 含靶碎片反冲)本站给不出——同 LET 的穿透 He 与质子在一层里不可分,一像素里的反冲与停止质子不可分,氢同位素的射程差落在像素量化里。账 15 落点 S3(登记预期 S2)。能给的最近量:全种类水中 >10 keV/µm 剂量份额,回收 0.177 对真值 0.178。
pois.detail_en: A single Timepix4 layer can genuinely separate only three classes, and the three chips are those: stopping tracks (energy below the 6.1 MeV crossing energy, projected length within the proton range, single-pixel or Bragg-rising), light through-going (LET ≤10 keV/µm) and heavy through-going. The proton-family ⟨Q⟩ that the glass works' account 22 asked for (p/d/t with target-fragment recoils) this station cannot supply: a through-going He and a proton at the same LET are indistinguishable in one layer, a recoil and a stopping proton in one pixel are indistinguishable, and the hydrogen isotopes' range difference sits inside the pixel quantisation. Ledger 15 lands on S3 (registered expectation S2). The nearest quantity it can give: the all-species dose share above 10 keV/µm water, recovered 0.177 against a truth of 0.178.

specs.p/d/t 停止径迹 ID: p 71–81% · d 16–18% · t 29–31% —— 20 µm 深度分辨几乎不帮忙(停止径迹太短,跨不过 4 个像素)
specs.反冲纯度(1 像素 1–5 MeV): 0.46,穿透否决后 0.48 —— 污染源是停止质子不是穿透离子,第二层符合救不了
specs.统计: σ_stat(⟨Q⟩_p) 0.004/sol —— 1.44 与 2.0 族的回收值差 0.63,统计上分得开,系统偏差 0.3–0.6 让它不准
specs.落点: S3:玻璃厂 unaudited 标记本站不可清;玻璃厂自己读

specs_en.p/d/t stopping-track ID: p 71–81% · d 16–18% · t 29–31% — 20 µm depth resolution barely helps (stopping tracks are too short to span 4 pixels)
specs_en.Recoil purity (1 pixel, 1–5 MeV): 0.46, 0.48 with a through-going veto — the contaminant is stopping protons, not through-going ions, so a second coincidence layer does not rescue it
specs_en.⟨Q⟩_p recovery bias (1.44 family): −0.28 (single layer) / −0.33 (veto): opposite in sign to the registration (+0.2 to +0.5)
specs_en.f_p recovery bias: +0.17 to +0.21 (He falls into the family by LET); −0.09 for the 2.5 family
specs_en.Statistics: σ_stat(⟨Q⟩_p) 0.004 per sol — the 1.44 and 2.0 families differ by 0.63 in recovered value, statistically resolvable, but a 0.3–0.6 systematic bias makes it inaccurate
specs_en.⟨Q⟩_p ↔ f_hi (truth): 1.22: 2.7% · 1.43: 9.5% · 1.92: 27% · 2.53: 42% — f_hi is the family's dose share in 1–6 MeV stopping protons (Q 3–6) and recoils (Q ~12); the registered 'Q_hi≈20, 1.44⇔2%' arithmetic was wrong
specs_en.Landing: S3: the glass works' unaudited mark cannot be cleared from this side; the reading is the glass works' own

sim: 质子族分离账(账 15,预注册 e2c966e):六闸中 G15.1(p/d/t 射程标度 0.1%)与 G15.6(统计)绿,G15.2–G15.5 红——每一条红都是物理不是 bug:同 LET 的 He/p、一像素里的反冲/停止质子、像素量化里的氢同位素。G15.1 抓到一个真数值坑:0.08 MeV/u 以下 Bethe 对数项为负,原钳位 0.05 让射程积分带负段,p/t 标度偏 1.8%;改钳 0.15 MeV/u 后 0.02%
撤回(2026-09-09):2026-09-08 那句 CLAIMS 级「Q(L) 形状倾向结果 2」作为对火星值的预测撤回——⟨Q⟩_p = 1 + f_hi(Q_hi − 1),形状对 f_hi 什么都没说;check_foreign_constants 的 CLAIMS 条目同日改状态
三落点事先写死:S1 单层 10 sol 内 ≥3σ 分开 1.44/2.0 族;S2 需第二层否决或 σ_z≤20 µm(登记预期);S3 任何消融下混淆底大于两族之差。实际 S3:否决把 ⟨Q⟩_p 偏差从 −0.28 变成 −0.33,深度把 p 正确率从 71% 提到 81%——都没跨过 0.15 的门槛。三落点都不含火星数,玻璃厂的标记一个都不动
sim_en: Proton-family separation (ledger 15, pre-registered e2c966e): of six gates G15.1 (p/d/t range scaling 0.1%) and G15.6 (statistics) are green, G15.2–G15.5 red — every red is physics, not a bug: He/p at equal LET, recoil/stopping proton in one pixel, hydrogen isotopes inside the pixel quantisation. G15.1 caught a real numerical trap: below 0.08 MeV/u the Bethe log term is negative, the original clamp at 0.05 fed a negative segment into the range integral and the p/t scaling was off by 1.8%; with the clamp at 0.15 MeV/u it is 0.02%

Withdrawal (2026-09-09): the CLAIMS-grade remark of 2026-09-08, 'the shape of Q(L) leans toward outcome 2', is withdrawn as a prediction of the Mars value — ⟨Q⟩_p = 1 + f_hi(Q_hi − 1) and the shape says nothing about f_hi; the CLAIMS entry in check_foreign_constants changed status the same day

Three landings written before the numbers: S1 single layer separates the 1.44/2.0 families at ≥3σ within 10 sols; S2 needs a second-layer veto or σ_z≤20 µm (registered expectation); S3 the confusion floor exceeds the families' difference under every ablation. Actual: S3 — the veto moves the ⟨Q⟩_p bias from −0.28 to −0.33 and depth lifts the p ID from 71% to 81%, neither crossing the 0.15 threshold. None of the three contains a Mars number; none moves the glass works' mark
pois.physics: LET ∝ z²/β²:β/2 的质子与 β 的 He 在硅里留下完全相同的能量密度,一层薄硅没有第二个观测量把它们分开;停止径迹的种类靠 (E, R) 曲线,但 ≤6 MeV 的 p/d/t 射程差只有一两个像素;ICRP 60 的 Q(L) 在水中 10 keV/µm 以下恒为 1,质子只在 ~4 MeV 以下越线——所以族的 ⟨Q⟩ 全由 1–6 MeV 停止质子和反冲的剂量份额 f_hi 决定,而 f_hi 是输运量,不是仪器量:玻璃厂在 Geant4 里算它,本站要量它得先把这三种混淆解开。
pois.physics_en: LET ∝ z²/β²: a proton at β/2 and a helium at β leave exactly the same energy density in silicon, and one thin layer has no second observable to tell them apart; a stopping track's species comes from its (E, R) curve, but the p/d/t range difference below 6 MeV is one or two pixels; ICRP 60's Q(L) is 1 below 10 keV/µm in water and a proton crosses that line only below ~4 MeV — so the family's ⟨Q⟩ is set entirely by the dose share f_hi of 1–6 MeV stopping protons and recoils, and f_hi is a transport quantity, not an instrument quantity: the glass works computes it in Geant4, and this station would have to resolve the three confusions above before it could measure it.

pois.label: SEP 警报塔
pois.detail: 三色灯柱吃的是 1 分钟滑动计数:绿=平静 GCR 本底;黄=计数爬升(>3× 平静);红+警铃=太阳质子事件到达(>30× 平静)。红警三动作:EVA 立即回舱、veh-heli-01 停飞(与气象站 τ>2 停飞并列同一块牌)、发射窗口冻结。计数率比剂量累积快得多,但**本站自己的提前量结构性为零**:触发警铃的就是开始记剂量的那批粒子——硬能带首批 17 min 就到、到 32 min 补齐,警报与剂量自始至终同步。全城的提前量来自轨道两级链——com-l4-01 日冕仪看 CME 起飞(1–3 天结构预报)→ com-polar-01 极轨 EPS 在大气层顶之上看全谱粒子前锋(~77 min 可动作窗口——是对预报可动作,不是地面余量)→ 城内警报。本站是这条链的**剂量峰实测端**,并在链路中断时充当自主兜底警铃。这里的 3×/30× 同时是**全城地表 SEP 事件的单一判据源**,由本站芯片评估一次、以事件态发布,免得同一场耀斑出现「这边判 SEP、那边判堆泄漏」的矛盾处置。聚变围界的中子哨兵柱据此给中子道开门——但两个「先」必须分清:**门控的先**是哨兵柱同一台仪器内带电道先于中子道、秒级,这才是判据本身;**天地的先**其实**不存在时间意义上的先**:同一能段,轨道比地表只早一个光程差 **0.07 s**——多 GeV 质子轻松穿透大气,两层同一刻看见。轨道真正独有的是**次截止 10–166 MeV 那群**永不落地的粒子,它给出的是**事件大小的预报**,是谱的优势不是时间的优势;77 min 也只是自由空间的弥散间隔。**真实泄漏在天上没有任何前兆**:先验只能把一次已经发生的中子抬升归类为 SEP 所致,不构成、也不得被读成对堆事件的提前预警。所以归类只做标记、不做扣除——事件期间泄漏判据仍然在岗,并按最小可信 SEP 贡献评估,否则一场耀斑正好把一次真泄漏藏起来。**现状要说清**:运行方册里目前**没有泄漏探测链、没有事故响应逻辑、零辐射监测触发源**——所以这道门今天没有消费者,既不存在 SEP 误触发风险,**保障也同样为零**;上述判据已被运行方记为建链时的设计前置约束。
pois.detail_en: The three-colour stack reads a 1-minute sliding count: green = quiet GCR background; yellow = counts climbing (>3× quiet); red + siren = solar proton event arrival (>30× quiet). Red-alert actions: EVA crews return immediately, veh-heli-01 grounded (sharing one sign with the weather station's τ>2 no-fly), launch windows frozen. Count rate beats dose accumulation for speed, but **this station's own lead time is structurally zero**: the particles that trip the siren are the particles that start the dose — the hard band opens at 17 min and fills in by 32 min, and alarm and dose track each other throughout. The city's lead time comes from the two-tier orbital chain — com-l4-01's coronagraph watches the CME depart (1–3 day structural forecast) → com-polar-01's polar EPS reads the full-spectrum particle front from above the atmosphere (~77 min actionable window — actionable on the forecast, not ground margin) → city alert. This station is that chain's **dose-peak ground truth**, and its autonomous backstop siren when the downlink is out. Its 3×/30× thresholds are also the **city's single source of truth for a surface SEP event**, evaluated once on this chip and published as an event state so that one flare can never produce 'SEP alert here, reactor leak there'. The neutron sentinel columns at the fusion perimeter gate their neutron channel on it — but two different precedences must not be confused: the **gate's precedence** is the sentinel's own charged channel leading its own neutron channel, inside one instrument, on a scale of seconds — that is the criterion itself; the **sky-to-ground precedence** does not exist in any temporal sense: at equal energy the orbiter leads the ground by one light-path difference, **0.07 s** — multi-GeV protons clear the atmosphere easily and both tiers see them in the same instant. What the orbital tier uniquely holds is the sub-cutoff 10–166 MeV population that never lands, and that buys a forecast of event **size** — a spectral advantage, not a temporal one. The 77 min, likewise, is only a free-space dispersion interval. **A real leak has no precursor in the sky**: the prior can classify a neutron rise that has *already begun* as SEP-driven; it does not constitute, and must never be read as, advance warning of a reactor event. So the classification only flags, it never subtracts — the leak criterion stays armed throughout an event and is evaluated against the smallest credible SEP contribution, or a flare becomes the perfect place to hide a real leak. **State it plainly**: the operator’s ledger today has no leak-detection chain, no accident-response logic and no radiation-monitoring trigger at all — so this gate has no consumer yet. There is no SEP false-trigger risk, and equally **no protection**; the criteria above are recorded as design preconditions for whenever such a chain is built.

specs_en.Red actions: EVA recall · helicopter grounded · launches frozen

sim: SEP 动态范围账(账4):平静 GCR ~198 hit/s/片(原写 62,2026-09-09 更正:62 用的是账 2 **假设**的平均簇 3 像素,账 14 的传感器模型在各向同性场上算得 9.5 像素——投影长均值 (π/2)×300 µm)→ 1972 级最坏硬谱 SEP ~2.0×10⁶ hit/s,仅为 Timepix4 读出上限 3.58 Ghit/s 的 5.5×10⁻⁴,像素死时间占比 8.6×10⁻⁶——相机在火星地表永不饱和,动态范围瓶颈在遥测带宽不在芯片

预警链接口账(账5,应 com-gap 交接复核):独立复现其 ~77 min 窗口(2.04 AU 帕克线上 100 MeV 39.6 min / 10 MeV 117.1 min,差 77.5 min)PASS;本站硬能带首批 17.0 min(相对论下限)到、166 MeV 截止能量 32.2 min 补齐,自身弥散展宽 15.2 min——但**自主提前量仍为 0**:触发警报的就是开始记剂量的那批粒子。(**撤回**:本账初版把这 15.2 min 命名为「轨道对地表剂量起始的领先」,经 com-gap 定义质询确认是**误命名**——GeV 质子远在大气截止之上、地表同刻可见,这段展宽两层共享;同能段轨道只早一个光程差 0.07 s);地面自主报警随事件硬度生死:S3 硬谱(γ=1.5)31× 平静直接红警,S3 软谱(γ=3.5)仅 0.11× 平静连黄警都不到——所以兜底可以有、预报必须来自轨道

次级中子源账(账6,应 SiC 哨兵网请求复核其门控假设):地表 SEP 中子预算里 19%(硬谱)–93%(软谱)来自 10–166 MeV 次截止质子——它们到不了地面、对带电道零贡献,所以两道不同源;>166 MeV 质子在风化层射程仅 21 g/cm² 对作用长度 100 g/cm²,五次里四次纯电离停下不产中子。门控次序可证明安全:中子道仅 0.18% | 0.26%(行 2 区间 0.18–0.36%)由 GCR 喂((2026-09-19 围界终裁 RULING_fence_after_b:条件 (ii) 已在机器链上实测满足、扣留解除。竖线左边是行 1——交付件所印 T,可引用,b 未应用;对屏蔽它是保守的,对围界它却是舒服的那个。右边是行 2——按本链实测 b 过六缝,以混凝土上测得的 b 在六缝上都成立为条件,其中四缝在别的材料里、该链未测。两行并列,不合并))(该道组成是哨兵网的仪器参数,规范值在其卡,此处只为让导出结论可读),分数响应比带电道弱 243–993× | 176–717×,带电道爬到 3× 开门时中子道才动 0.2–0.82% | 0.28–1.14%——**在已建屏蔽 0.30 m 下(不再是假设)**任何硬度的 SEP 都无法「中子道先跳」绕过门控。**这条证明有前提,必须写出来**:余量来自中子道只有 0.18% | 0.26% 由 GCR 喂,而该占比 = GCR份额/(泄漏底座+GCR份额)——**屏蔽越厚泄漏底座越小,余量反而越薄**。本账算出的临界是 GCR 占比 45%(等效屏蔽再厚 0.66 m | 0.63 m),当前对应 243× | 176× 的裕度(行 2 区间 126–250×);哨兵网表里那行「有条件的试验载荷,不是读数」下为 105×;每一行上次序都成立——**但这个倍数已不可单值引用**:运行方回执带来两个方向相反的修正。①运行点由 848 改为 640 MW(S_n ×0.755),泄漏底座同比下调,若 2 m 成立则裕度收到约 40×;②**运行方册里根本没有生物屏蔽设计**(其几何止于 TF 线圈,恒温器外一层未建模)——那 2 m 混凝土是哨兵网**完全自设**,不是"待确认"而是**不存在对应设计**;若实际屏障仅为恒温器壁,底座会高得多、裕度反而更厚。厚度进指数(1 TVL=0.25 m=一个数量级),恒温器外源项尚未计算之前两个方向都开着。**所以请引判据不要引倍数**:次序成立 ⟺ 泄漏底座 > GCR份额 × (最大标度 − 1)。越界只在软谱,而软谱绝对增幅可忽略,故处置不变——变的是这句话的条件性
sim_en: SEP dynamic-range ledger (#4): quiet GCR ~198 hit/s/chip (formerly 62, corrected 2026-09-09: 62 used ledger 2's ASSUMED 3-pixel mean cluster; ledger 14's sensor model gives 9.5 pixels on an isotropic field, mean projected length (π/2)×300 µm) → a worst-case 1972-class hard-spectrum SEP gives ~2.0×10⁶ hit/s, just 5.5×10⁻⁴ of the Timepix4 readout ceiling of 3.58 Ghit/s, with a pixel dead-time fraction of 8.6×10⁻⁶ — the camera never saturates on the Martian surface; the dynamic-range bottleneck is telemetry, not the chip

Warning-chain interface ledger (#5, cross-checking the com-gap handoff): their ~77 min window reproduces independently (100 MeV at 39.6 min, 10 MeV at 117.1 min over the 2.04 AU Parker path, difference 77.5 min) — PASS; this station's penetrating band opens at the relativistic floor of 17.0 min and is complete by 32.2 min at the 166 MeV cutoff — a dispersion spread of 15.2 min — yet its autonomous lead time is still 0, because the particles that trip the alarm are the ones that start the dose. (**Retracted**: this ledger's first version named that 15.2 min 'the orbital lead over the onset of surface dose'; com-gap's definitional challenge showed it was a misnaming — GeV protons sit far above the atmospheric cutoff and the ground sees them in the same instant, so the spread belongs to both tiers, and at equal energy the orbiter leads by one light path, 0.07 s); and a ground-only alarm lives or dies on event hardness: a hard S3 (γ=1.5) reaches 31× quiet and trips red, while a soft S3 (γ=3.5) reaches 0.11× quiet and never even trips yellow — a backstop is worth having, the forecast must come from orbit

Secondary-neutron source ledger (#6, cross-checking the SiC sentinel net's gate assumption): 19% (hard spectrum) to 93% (soft) of the surface SEP neutron budget comes from sub-cutoff 10–166 MeV protons that never reach the ground and contribute nothing to the charged channel — the two channels are not the same source; and a 166 MeV proton has only 21 g/cm² of range in regolith against a 100 g/cm² interaction length, so four times in five it simply stops without making a neutron. The gate's ordering is provably safe: the neutron channel is only 0.18% | 0.26% (row 2 interval 0.18–0.36%) GCR-fed (final fence ruling of 2026-09-19, RULING_fence_after_b: condition (ii) was measured and satisfied on the machine chain and the hold is released. Left of the bar is row 1 — T as printed by the delivery, quotable, b not applied; conservative for the shield and the comfortable one for the fence. Right of it is row 2 — the chain's own measured b over six joins, conditional on the b measured in borated concrete holding on all six, four of which are in other materials and unmeasured on that chain. The two are printed side by side and never merged) (that channel composition is the sentinel net’s own instrument parameter, normative in its card and quoted here only to make the derived result readable), its fractional response is 243–993× | 176–717× weaker than the charged channel's, and when the charged channel reaches the 3× gate the neutron channel has moved 0.2–0.82% | 0.28–1.14% — **under the BUILT 0.30 m shield (no longer an assumption)** no SEP of any hardness can arrive 'neutron-first' and outrun the gate. **That proof has a premise and the premise must be stated**: the margin comes from the neutron channel being only 0.18% | 0.26% GCR-fed, and that share is GCR/(leakage baseline + GCR) — **so thicker shielding, by shrinking the leakage baseline, erodes the very margin**. This ledger puts the break-even at a 45% GCR share, i.e. 0.66 m | 0.63 m more shielding; today's share corresponds to a margin of 243× | 176× (row 2 interval 126–250×); under the row the sentinel table labels “a conditional test load, not a reading” it is 105×; the ordering holds on every row — **but that factor can no longer be quoted as a single number**: the operator's reply brings two corrections pointing opposite ways. (i) the plant moved from 848 to 640 MW (S_n x0.755), scaling the leakage baseline down and, if the 2 m held, tightening the margin to about 40x; (ii) **the operator's ledger contains no biological shielding design at all** — its geometry stops at the TF coils — so the 2 m of concrete is entirely the sentinel session's own construct, not 'pending confirmation' but absent, and if the real barrier is only the cryostat wall the baseline is far higher and the margin far larger. Thickness enters exponentially (1 TVL = 0.25 m = one decade), and until the cryostat-external source term is computed both directions stay open. **So quote the criterion, not the factor**: ordering holds iff leakage baseline > GCR share x (max scaling - 1). Crossing the line affects soft spectra only, whose absolute enhancement is negligible, so handling is unchanged — what changes is that the statement is conditional
pois.physics: Jezero 在基准面下 2.6 km,CO₂ 大气柱 20.7 g/cm² = 166 MeV 质子的射程(斜程通量加权约 245 MeV)——只有 SEP 的硬谱尾够得着地面,地表增幅因此远小于自由空间,也因为只剩硬尾,计数一跳就是真事件。反直觉的一环在时序:速度弥散让**高能最先到**,而大气恰恰只放行高能,所以地面看到的是最早的那批粒子、比 100 MeV「前锋」还早 7 min——地面不是迟到,而是**对自己的剂量没有提前量**:触发警报的就是开始记剂量的那批粒子。硬能带确实会弥散展开 15.2 min(相对论下限 17.0 min 到截止能量 32.2 min),但那段"首批到主体"的间隔也不可用于排班——它有多大取决于谱硬度(首批 >1 GeV 只占穿透通量的 6.5%〔硬谱〕到 0.2%〔软谱〕),而警报响的时候谱硬度还不知道,且这段时间剂量一直在累积。而且这不是某种谱型下的巧合——到达时间随能量严格单调递减,大气又恰是高通滤波器,两者相乘就是**恒等式**:无论事件谱硬谱软,地表都最先看见、且都没有余量。
pois.physics_en: Jezero sits 2.6 km below datum, so its CO₂ column is 20.7 g/cm² — the range of a 166 MeV proton (about 245 MeV once slant paths are flux-weighted). Only the hard tail of an SEP reaches the ground, which is why surface enhancement stays far below free space, and why any count jump here is a real event. The counter-intuitive part is the timing: velocity dispersion puts the **highest energies first**, and the atmosphere passes precisely those — so the ground sees the earliest particles of all, some 7 min ahead of the 100 MeV 'front'. The ground is not late; it simply has no lead over its own dose — the particles that trip the alarm are the ones that start the dose. The hard band does disperse over 15.2 min (relativistic floor 17.0 min to cutoff arrival 32.2 min), but that onset-to-bulk interval is not schedulable either: its size depends on spectral hardness (the first-arriving >1 GeV fraction is 6.5% of the penetrating flux for a hard spectrum but 0.2% for a soft one), hardness is unknown when the alarm sounds, and dose accrues throughout.

pois.label: EVA 个人剂量牌充电架
pois.detail: 八个卡槽,出舱前取牌、回舱后归位充电回读。牌上积的是 Q 加权剂量当量——与主相机同一套刻度。绿灯=充满且已回读。SEP 红警时这排空槽就是撤收清单——但**别拿 77 min 当排班余量**。那是自由空间的弥散间隔——而且是"无散射光滑螺旋 + 良好磁连接"下的**上界**、不是保证下限(限定由 com-gap 随该数给出);而撤收是**剂量累积**问题:真正的余量随事件大小走,F=10³ 时约 4.5 小时,F=10⁴ 时只剩 **~27 min**(到 ICRP 职业年限),**比 77 还短**。而且轨道 EPS **对地表没有任何时间领先**:同一能段只早一个光程差 0.07 s。EPS 买的是**事件大小的预报**,不是撤收时间。所以规程按最坏情形写:**红警即回舱,不按窗口算**;清点在这里完成。
pois.detail_en: Eight slots: take a badge before EVA, dock it after for charging and readout. Badges integrate Q-weighted dose equivalent on the same calibration as the main camera. Green light = charged and read out. During an SEP red alert the empty slots are the recall checklist — but **do not schedule against the 77 min**. That figure is a dispersion interval in free space — and an **upper bound** assuming a smooth Parker spiral with no scattering and good magnetic connection, not a guaranteed floor (the qualification travels with the number, per com-gap) — while a recall is a **dose-accumulation** problem: the real margin tracks event size, about 4.5 hours at F=10³ and only **~27 min** at F=10⁴ (to the ICRP occupational annual limit) — **shorter than 77**. And the orbital EPS holds **no timing lead over the surface at all**: at equal energy it leads by one light-path difference, 0.07 s. What the EPS buys is a forecast of event **size**, not recall time. So the procedure is written for the worst case: **red alert means return now, not return within a window** — and the roll-call happens here.

specs.红警撤收余量: 非固定值,随事件大小:F=10³ ~4.5 h · F=10⁴ ~27 min(账5)

specs_en.Red-alert recall margin: not a fixed number — tracks event size: ~4.5 h at F=10³, ~27 min at F=10⁴ (ledger #5)

pois.sim: 剂量账(账1,RAD 锚点):0.21 mGy/day 吸收 · <Q>=3.05 · 0.64 mSv/day → 0.66 mSv/sol、234 mSv/yr,与居住区覆土卡「~230 mSv/yr(无屏蔽)」闭合;巡航 1.84 mSv/day ÷ 行星阴影 2×(假设,非实测)÷ 大气 24.4 g/cm²(Gale 实地柱,RAD 测点)三点闭合反演 λ_H=67 g/cm²。【前向指针,2026-09-09】这四个数是 RAD 积分的**引用**,不是本站测量;账 14–17 定义了本站出谱后取代它们的产品(P1 的 D、H 积分),RAD 届时改作已知答案闸而非来源;账 1 从未写明 0.21 mGy/day 是硅中还是水中剂量(差 ~1.2–1.3×),已登记为锚的未决项
pois.sim_en: Dose ledger (#1, RAD anchors): 0.21 mGy/day absorbed · <Q>=3.05 · 0.64 mSv/day → 0.66 mSv/sol, 234 mSv/yr — closing with the hab mound card's '~230 mSv/yr (unshielded)'; cruise 1.84 mSv/day ÷ 2× planetary shadow (an assumption, not a measurement) ÷ Gale’s own 24.4 g/cm² column (RAD measured there) closes to λ_H = 67 g/cm². [Forward pointer, 2026-09-09] These four numbers are QUOTED RAD integrals, not this station's measurement; ledgers 14-17 define the product (P1 integrals for D and H) that replaces them once the station has data, with RAD demoted to the known-answer gate; ledger 1 never states whether the 0.21 mGy/day is dose in silicon or in water (a 1.2-1.3x difference), now an open item on the anchor
pois.physics: 剂量当量 = 吸收剂量 × 品质因子 Q(LET);火星地表 <Q>≈3,因为 GCR 里的重离子虽少,单条径迹的生物破坏力却按 LET 加权——正是大屏上那几颗红斑贡献了不成比例的 mSv。
pois.physics_en: Dose equivalent = absorbed dose × quality factor Q(LET); on Mars <Q>≈3 because GCR heavy ions are rare but each track's biological damage is LET-weighted — the few red blobs on the screen carry a disproportionate share of the mSv.

pois.label: 中子转换层剖切块
pois.detail: 探测头 B/C 层的 100 倍放大剖面,颜色与塔顶真件一一对应:白=聚乙烯转换层,浅绿=⁶LiF 膜,深蓝=300 µm 硅,铜色=Timepix4 读出芯片。白色箭头是入射中子,橙色箭头是它撞出的反冲质子拐进硅里——中子被看见的那一下。
pois.detail_en: A 100× cutaway of head layers B/C, colour-matched to the real stack on the tower: white = polyethylene converter, pale green = 6LiF film, dark blue = 300 µm silicon, copper = the Timepix4 readout ASIC. The white arrow is an incoming neutron; the amber arrow is the recoil proton it knocks into the silicon — the instant a neutron becomes visible.
pois.sim: 中子账(账3)的反冲逃逸 MC:反冲质子各向同性生成于转换层任意深度,按 CH₂ 射程判断能否带着 >150 keV 钻进硅——逃逸因子把 1 mm HDPE 的相互作用概率 0.95–3% 折成有效效率 0.02–0.39%;转换层不是越厚越好,厚了质子出不来
pois.sim_en: Recoil-escape MC of ledger #3: recoil protons born isotropically at any converter depth, tested by CH₂ range for reaching the silicon with >150 keV — the escape factor turns the 1 mm HDPE interaction probability of 0.95–3% into an effective 0.02–0.39%; thicker is not better, the protons simply fail to get out
pois.physics: 反照中子是火星特产:GCR 打进 regolith,蒸发中子再漏出地面——所以这台相机有一半时间在看「脚下」而不是天上。
pois.physics_en: Albedo neutrons are a Martian specialty: GCR strikes the regolith and evaporation neutrons leak back out of the ground — so half of what this camera watches is underfoot, not overhead.

pois.label: 监测亭与数据链
pois.detail: 设备柜里做的事:径迹分类在站内完成,回传的只是分类计数与谱摘要——SEP 账证明芯片不会饱和,真正的量程瓶颈是遥测带宽,所以把分类智能放在山上。八木天线指向 com-station-01,太阳板 + 内部电池过夜。
pois.detail_en: What the cabinet does: track classification happens on-station; only class counts and spectral summaries go home — ledger #4 proves the chip never saturates, the real bottleneck is telemetry bandwidth, so the classification brains live on the hill. The Yagi points at com-station-01; a solar panel plus internal battery rides out the night.

specs.站内处理: 径迹分类 + 1 分钟滑动计数

specs_en.Power: solar panel + battery through the night

pois.sim: AFE 台账(Codex 战役):校准 DAC 像素 5/5 PVT 角通过、局部功耗 <20 µW/像素;追踪镜 hybrid8 分支 27/27 PVT 闭合、20/20 瞬态噪声 q300 检出 0/20 占用
pois.sim_en: AFE ledger (Codex campaign): calibrated DAC pixel passes 5/5 PVT corners under the 20 µW/pixel local power gate; the tracking-mirror hybrid8 branch closes 27/27 PVT points with 20/20 transient-noise q300 detection at 0/20 occupancy
pois.physics: 带宽经济学:一次重离子事件的科学含量在簇形态里,不在原始帧里——站内把 10⁵ 像素/秒折叠成 3 个数字/分钟,链路预算立刻从不可能变成随手。
pois.physics_en: Bandwidth economics: the science of a heavy-ion event lives in the cluster shape, not the raw frame — folding 10⁵ pixels/s into 3 numbers/min on-station turns the link budget from impossible into trivial.

pois.label: 三层辐射网 · 地表层
pois.detail: 同一场 SEP,三层各有一句台词:轨道 MiniPAN(sci-pan-01)给出一次粒子能谱与首报;地表这里屏上下起质子雨、警报塔转红;地下城玄关的 SiC 哨兵(30 m 岩下)每 ~83 秒一跳如常,深地哨兵纹丝不动——全城屏蔽账从「算出来的」变成「测出来的」。旁边那块双色牌与气象站共用:琥珀=τ>2 尘暴停飞,红=SEP 红警,两个停飞理由并排挂在环境预警组团同一根杆上。
pois.detail_en: One SEP, three tiers, three lines: orbital MiniPAN (sci-pan-01) delivers the primary spectrum and first warning; here on the surface the screen fills with proton rain and the tower goes red; the SiC sentinel in the undercity foyer (under 30 m of rock) keeps its usual ~83 s blip, and the deep-lab sentinel does not stir — the city's shielding budget goes from calculated to measured. The two-colour sign is shared with the weather station: amber = τ>2 dust no-fly, red = SEP alert — both grounding reasons hang on one pole of the environmental-alert cluster.

specs.轨道层: MiniPAN:一次粒子能谱 + 触发时序
specs.地表层(本站): 分类计数 + 剂量当量 + 红警
specs.玄关(30 m 岩): µ 道 ~83 s/跳,SEP 无感

specs_en.Surface (here): class counts + dose equivalent + red alert

sim: 地表半张对表:SEP 地表增幅可达 10³–10⁴×(账4),而玄关 7800 g/cm² = 52 个强子 e 折长度——大气只放行 >166 MeV(账5 按 Jezero 真实柱重算),岩层再杀 e⁻⁵²,地下层对 SEP 结构性免疫(对表 mars_rad_sic 账3)
剂量互证闭环:RAD 锚点 234 mSv/yr(原写「本站实测」,2026-09-09 更正:本站尚无任何实测,这是 RAD 积分的引用;账 14–17 之后由本站 P1 产品的积分取代) ↔ 居住区覆土卡 ~230 mSv/yr ↔ 覆土 10 m 后落到 μ 子地板 ~0.3 mSv/yr(=地球海平面宇宙线,账1)
sim_en: Surface half of the cross-table: SEP surface enhancement reaches 10³–10⁴× (ledger #4), while the foyer sits under 7800 g/cm² = 52 hadronic e-folds — the atmosphere admits only >166 MeV (recomputed from Jezero's true column in ledger #5) and the rock kills another e⁻⁵², making the underground tier structurally SEP-blind (cross-checked with mars_rad_sic ledger #3)

Dose closure loop: the RAD anchor's 234 mSv/yr (formerly written 'this station's', corrected 2026-09-09: the station has measured nothing yet, this is a quoted RAD integral; replaced by the integral of the station's P1 product after ledgers 14-17) ↔ the hab mound card's ~230 mSv/yr ↔ ~0.3 mSv/yr muon floor under 10 m of regolith (= Earth sea-level cosmic, ledger #1)
pois.physics: 三层看的是同一束 GCR/SEP 在不同屏蔽深度下的截面:自由空间的能谱、20.7 g/cm² 大气后的径迹(Jezero 本地柱)、7800 g/cm² 岩石后的寂静。把三块屏并排读,衰减长度本身就显形了。
pois.physics_en: The three tiers are cross-sections of the same GCR/SEP beam at different shielding depths: the spectrum in free space, the tracks behind Jezero’s own 20.7 g/cm² of atmosphere, the silence behind 7800 g/cm² of rock. Read the three screens side by side and the attenuation length itself becomes visible.
